newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso seen hovering around 29 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso seen hovering around 29 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine peso is expected to remain under pressure despite a new ruling of the central bank cutting banks' long dollar position to five percent from 10 percent of capital, traders said.
They said the peso will hover around 29 to the dollar, the same rate at which it closed on Wednesday.
"The import season will last up to October. And exporters are not yet convinced to unload their dollars since the currency volatility in the region is persisting," a foreign bank dealer said.
"Banks are a little squarish to a little long right now. And if they do unload their dollars to correct their positions, the impact won't be that much," the trader added.
